audio_script.text_en: Hello, Ms. Lindqvist. This is Carlos calling from Artisan Woodworks. I'm pleased to let you know that our craftsmen have finished applying the protective finish to your custom walnut conference table, and it's ready for delivery this Thursday.
However, when I contacted your office building's property manager this morning, she informed me that the main freight elevator is undergoing routine cable maintenance until noon on Thursday.

Because the tabletop is three meters long, our crew cannot bring it up the passenger elevators. We've therefore scheduled your delivery window for between two and four P.M., once the freight elevator is back in service. Please call me back at 555-0192 to confirm that someone in your suite will be available to sign for the shipment.

Also, please remember that flash photography is strictly prohibited inside Gallery B to protect the fragile parchment sea charts. Now, let's walk over to the security desk so each of you can pick up your name badge and floor assignment sheet.

audio_script.text_en: Attention, morning shift crew. Before we begin loading the refrigerated trucks for our dairy distributors, I want to review a new safety protocol that goes into effect today across all cold-storage bays.

Over the weekend, technicians installed digital thermal alarms above each freezer door. If a freezer door remains open for more than ninety seconds while forklifts are moving pallets, an amber warning light will flash.

We certainly don't want a repeat of last month's spoiled yogurt incident. So if you see that amber light flashing, pause your forklift transfers immediately and close the insulated curtain before proceeding. Finally, anyone whose thermal gloves are worn out can exchange them for a new pair at the equipment cage.

audio_script.text_en: May I have your attention, please. Due to dense coastal fog reducing visibility across the bay, all high-speed catamaran departures from Pier Seven to Bayside Financial District have been suspended until ten-thirty this morning.

To help commuters reach downtown offices with minimal delay, the Port Authority has arranged complimentary express shuttle buses that will depart every fifteen minutes from Bus Bay C, directly outside the west terminal doors.

Simply show your digital or paper ferry ticket to the bus driver when boarding. Passengers who prefer not to travel by bus may have their unused ferry fare refunded in full at Customer Service Window Three.

audio_script.text_en: Good afternoon, board members. Please turn your attention to the third-quarter regional performance table on the screen. Overall, three of our four domestic territories posted positive revenue growth this quarter.

As you can see, the territory whose top-selling category was espresso machines achieved an impressive eleven-point-five percent jump in revenue. However, that same region also recorded an unusually high product return rate of six-point-eight percent.

Customer survey cards indicate that the espresso machines themselves aren't defective; rather, buyers find the decalcifying instructions in the printed manual confusing. Meanwhile, for the single region that experienced a slight revenue decline, we plan to launch a targeted social media campaign in October to boost robotic vacuum sales before the holiday shopping season.
